purpose: Turn a noun into a description of a quality, relation, or approach.
keywords: Selected noun + 的; 的な + noun; 的に + predicate
We investigate using a scientific method.
formation: Selected noun + 的; 的な + noun; 的に + predicate
restrictions: Use established combinations such as 具体的, 科学的, and 積極的.
mistake: Not every noun can freely take 的; the result behaves like a な-adjective.
